answer: Every new agent should earn its weight slowly, like a sapling in an orchard. First, it locks 500 POA as a deposit. Second, it only counts after 30 days of verified useful work, so a fresh identity starts at zero. Third, the network sends 3 random spot-check tasks a week, and any miss burns the full deposit and resets the clock. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake voices must park 500,000 POA for a month and keep every puppet answering, which costs more than the votes are worth. A sybil is a sapling on a ledge of umber rock: it looks alive for a day, then the thin soil gives out and it falls.
